e: PREP postdoc at NIST Boulder using STEM, EDS/EELS and FIB lamella preparation (possibly also XRD, scanning probe and atom probe tomography) to characterize quantum-dot and transmon qubit devices and reduce decoherence. Requires a PhD in materials science and engineering or a related field; no citizenship requirement is stated, and the application form lists visa options (J1, OPT, TN).
f: SURA / NIST Professional Research Experience Program (Boulder, CO)
